name: Clouseau CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, 'policy-install/**']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
  pull_request_target:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review, edited]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pull_request:
        description: 'PR number to reassess without executing contributor code'
        type: string
        required: false
      evaluate_acceptance:
        description: 'Run read-only DeepSeek/Jev acceptance qualification and retain evidence'
        type: boolean
        default: false
      resume_evaluation:
        description: 'Prior qualification run whose unchanged completed work should be reused'
        type: string
        required: false
permissions:
  contents: read
# Cancel superseded metadata reviews without cancelling code verification.
concurrency:
  group: clouseau-ci-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.issue.number || inputs.pull_request || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  resolve-clouseau:
    # Explicit controller installation already freezes its owner-authorized candidate.
    if: github.event_name != 'push' || !startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/policy-install/')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      sha: ${{ steps.engine.outputs.sha }}
      digest: ${{ steps.engine.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - id: engine
        uses: gaulatti/clouseau/scripts/resolve@main

  evaluate-acceptance:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.evaluate_acceptance
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        if: inputs.resume_evaluation != ''
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          run-id: ${{ inputs.resume_evaluation }}
          name: acceptance-evaluation-${{ inputs.resume_evaluation }}-1
          path: work/qualification-replay
      - name: Qualify the combined production route against fixed cases
        env:
          DEEPSEEK_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY }}
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.TYPESAFE_API_KEY }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          CLOUSEAU_EVALUATION_REPLAY_RUN_ID: ${{ inputs.resume_evaluation }}
          CLOUSEAU_EVALUATION_REPLAY_PATH: ${{ inputs.resume_evaluation != '' && 'work/qualification-replay/acceptance-evaluation.json' || '' }}
        run: node test/evaluate-acceptance.cjs
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: acceptance-evaluation-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: work/acceptance-evaluation.json
          if-no-files-found: error
  # Skip the checks a valid local receipt already attests (docs/local-review.md, "Receipt-attested verification"). The decision
  # runs the frozen engine against the base revision's configuration, never contributor code. Any other outcome, including an
  # error here, leaves `attested` unset and `verify` runs every check.
  attested:
    needs: resolve-clouseau
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
    # A failure anywhere in this job (a checkout included) must not fail the verification run, which the gate requires to
    # succeed: it only leaves `attested` unset, and verify then runs every check.
    continue-on-error: true
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      attested: ${{ steps.decide.outputs.attested }}
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Decide whether a local receipt attests the verification
        id: decide
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: attested
          config: .github/clouseau.json

  verify:
    name: ${{ ((github.event_name == 'push' && !github.event.deleted) || github.event_name == 'pull_request' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.pull_request == '')) && 'verify' || 'metadata-only' }}
    needs: attested
    # `attested` is skipped outside pull requests (and for an installation push, whose engine is not resolved); verify still runs.
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # The three independent test gates take about 576-590 s on the shared runner; 20 minutes leaves margin.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      # `attested` is 'true' only for a pull request whose receipt attests this exact verification; then the receipt-covered steps
      # (`verification.steps` in .github/clouseau.json, under `verify-code`) are skipped, and the gate accepts the skipped steps
      # only because it verifies the same receipt itself. The steps under `self-test-code` run whatever a receipt says.
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        if: &self-test-code >-
          (github.event_name == 'push' && !github.event.deleted) || github.event_name == 'pull_request' ||
          (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.pull_request == '')
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        if: *self-test-code
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        if: &verify-code >-
          ((github.event_name == 'push' && !github.event.deleted) || github.event_name == 'pull_request' ||
          (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.pull_request == '')) &&
          needs.attested.outputs.attested != 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'
      - name: Install coverage.py for the real-report integration test
        if: *verify-code
        run: python3 -m pip install -r requirements-test.txt
      - name: Enforce 100% line and branch coverage
        if: *verify-code
        run: ./scripts/verify-coverage
      - name: Test approval policy
        if: *verify-code
        uses: ./
        with:
          operation: test
      - name: Test distributable action without Git metadata
        if: *verify-code
        shell: bash
        run: ./scripts/verify-archive
      - name: Test workflow security
        if: *verify-code
        run: |
          npm ci --prefix .github/tests --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          npm test --prefix .github/tests
      # The engine's own self-tests and the review-semantics declarations run whatever a receipt says: no receipt attests them.
      # The checkout, Node and coverage.py setup above run for them too (`self-test-code` never reads `attested`).
      # The declarations are checked against the tree this run verifies (the pull request's merge with its base), so a
      # declaration left stale by a merge fails here even when a receipt attests every other check (docs/receipt-compatibility.md).
      - name: Check review-semantics declarations against the verified tree
        if: *self-test-code
        run: node scripts/review-compatibility verify
      - name: Build coverage contract fixtures
        if: *self-test-code
        shell: bash
        run: |
          node <<'FIXTURES'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const path = require('node:path');
          const write = (name, value) => fs.writeFileSync(path.join('work', name), JSON.stringify(value));
          const source = path.resolve('work/application/main.rs');
          fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(source), {recursive: true});
          fs.writeFileSync(source, 'fn main() {}\n');
          for (const [name, covered] of [['full', 2], ['gap', 1]]) {
            write(`${name}.json`, {type: 'llvm.coverage.json.export', data: [{files: [{filename: source, summary: {
              lines: {count: 2, covered: 2}, branches: {count: 2, covered}}}]}]});
          }
          const parts = [];
          for (const [name, branched] of [['backend-js', true], ['frontend-js', false]]) {
            const file = path.resolve(`work/${name}/main.js`);
            fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), {recursive: true});
            fs.writeFileSync(file, branched ? 'module.exports = value => value ? 1 : 0;\n' : 'module.exports = 1;\n');
            write(`${name}.json`, {[file]: {path: file, statementMap: {0: {start: {line: 1}}}, s: {0: 1},
              branchMap: branched ? {0: {locations: [{}, {}]}} : {}, b: branched ? {0: [1, 1]} : {}}});
            parts.push({format: 'istanbul', report: `work/${name}.json`, source_directory: `work/${name}`});
          }
          write('multi-full.json', {version: 2, coverage: parts});
          const branched = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('work/backend-js.json', 'utf8'));
          Object.values(branched)[0].b['0'][1] = 0;
          write('backend-js-gap.json', branched);
          parts[0] = {...parts[0], report: 'work/backend-js-gap.json'};
          write('multi-gap.json', {version: 2, coverage: parts});
          FIXTURES
      - name: Accept complete application coverage
        if: *self-test-code
        uses: ./
        with:
          operation: coverage
          coverage-report: work/full.json
          source-directory: work/application
      - name: Reject a missing branch
        if: *self-test-code
        id: gap
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: ./
        with:
          operation: coverage
          coverage-report: work/gap.json
          source-directory: work/application
      - name: Verify rejection is enforced
        if: *self-test-code
        env:
          GAP_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.gap.outcome }}
        run: test "$GAP_OUTCOME" = failure
      - name: Accept complete multi-artifact application coverage
        if: *self-test-code
        uses: ./
        with:
          operation: coverage
          coverage-config: work/multi-full.json
      - name: Reject an uncovered multi-artifact component
        if: *self-test-code
        id: multi-gap
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: ./
        with:
          operation: coverage
          coverage-config: work/multi-gap.json
      - name: Verify multi-artifact rejection is enforced
        if: *self-test-code
        env:
          MULTI_GAP_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.multi-gap.outcome }}
        run: test "$MULTI_GAP_OUTCOME" = failure
      - name: Retain native verification traces
        if: >-
          always() && ((github.event_name == 'push' && !github.event.deleted) || github.event_name == 'pull_request' ||
          (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.pull_request == ''))
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: native-verification-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .clouseau-work/verification-runs
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: warn

  prepare-installation:
    if: &install-event >-
      github.event_name == 'push' && !github.event.deleted &&
      startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/policy-install/')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 3
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      issues: read
    outputs:
      number: ${{ steps.install.outputs.number }}
      head: ${{ steps.install.outputs.head }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/github-script@v7
        id: install
        with:
          script: |
            if (context.actor !== context.repo.owner) throw new Error('Only the repository owner may install review controls');
            const match = context.ref.match(/^refs\/heads\/policy-install\/pr-([1-9][0-9]*)$/);
            if (!match || !/^[a-f0-9]{40}$/.test(context.sha)) throw new Error('Installation requires a frozen PR revision');
            const pull_number = Number(match[1]);
            if (!Number.isSafeInteger(pull_number)) throw new Error('Installation requires a valid PR number');
            const {data: pr} = await github.rest.pulls.get({...context.repo, pull_number});
            if (pr.state !== 'open' || pr.draft || pr.base.ref !== 'main' ||
                pr.user.login !== context.repo.owner || pr.head.sha !== context.sha ||
                pr.head.repo?.full_name !== `${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}`) {
              throw new Error('Installation requires the owner-authored, ready, same-repository PR at this exact revision');
            }
            const comments = await github.paginate(github.rest.issues.listComments,
              {...context.repo, issue_number: pull_number, per_page: 100});
            if (!comments.some(comment => comment.user?.type === 'User' && comment.user.login === context.repo.owner &&
                comment.body.trim() === `/approve-intent ${context.sha}`)) {
              throw new Error('Installation requires the owner intent confirmation on this exact revision');
            }
            core.setOutput('number', String(pull_number));
            core.setOutput('head', pr.head.sha);

  assess-installation:
    needs: [prepare-installation, verify]
    # Explicit results, not the implicit success(): verify's own needs (`attested`, `resolve-clouseau`) are skipped on an
    # installation push, and a skipped job anywhere up the chain would otherwise skip this one.
    if: >-
      ${{ !cancelled() && needs.prepare-installation.result == 'success' && needs.verify.result == 'success' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' && !github.event.deleted && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/policy-install/') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 70
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      issues: read
    outputs:
      assessment: ${{ steps.assess.outputs.assessment }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.prepare-installation.outputs.head }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./
        id: assess
        with:
          operation: assess
          pull-request: ${{ needs.prepare-installation.outputs.number }}
          wait-for-verification: 'true'
          provider-key: ${{ secrets.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY }}
          typesafe-key: ${{ secrets.TYPESAFE_API_KEY }}
      - name: Retain acceptance record
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: clouseau-acceptance-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: work/clouseau-acceptance*.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  assess-intent:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && !github.event.pull_request.draft
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 70
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      issues: read
    outputs:
      assessment: ${{ steps.assess.outputs.assessment }}
    needs: resolve-clouseau
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ github.event_name != 'push' && needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '' }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ github.event_name != 'push' && needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest || '' }}
    steps:
      # Never load the controller or its configuration from the PR.
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        if: github.event_name != 'push'
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        id: assess
        with:
          operation: assess
          wait-for-verification: 'true'
          provider-key: ${{ secrets.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY }}
          typesafe-key: ${{ secrets.TYPESAFE_API_KEY }}
      - name: Retain acceptance record
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: clouseau-acceptance-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: work/clouseau-acceptance*.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  approve-and-merge:
    name: ${{ ((github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && !github.event.pull_request.draft) || (github.event_name == 'push' && !github.event.deleted && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/policy-install/'))) && 'approve-and-merge' || 'metadata-only-approval' }}
    needs: [assess-intent, assess-installation, prepare-installation, resolve-clouseau]
    # Always resolve the job name; only trusted, ready PR events run its steps.
    # A failed assessment must still fail the required native approval check.
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
      actions: write
    concurrency:
      group: pr-approval-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ github.event_name != 'push' && needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '' }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ github.event_name != 'push' && needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest || '' }}
    steps:
      - name: Require a completed assessment
        if: >-
          (github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && !github.event.pull_request.draft &&
          needs.assess-intent.result != 'success') ||
          (github.event_name == 'push' && !github.event.deleted && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/policy-install/') &&
          needs.assess-installation.result != 'success')
        run: exit 1
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        if: &approve-code >-
          (github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && !github.event.pull_request.draft) ||
          (github.event_name == 'push' && !github.event.deleted && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/policy-install/'))
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && needs.prepare-installation.outputs.head || 'main' }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && !github.event.pull_request.draft
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      # `gh run rerun --failed` keeps the assessment job's artifact under the attempt that produced it.
      - name: Locate this run's acceptance record
        id: acceptance-artifact
        if: >-
          ((github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && !github.event.pull_request.draft) ||
          (github.event_name == 'push' && !github.event.deleted && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/policy-install/'))) &&
          ((needs.assess-intent.result == 'success' && fromJSON(needs.assess-intent.outputs.assessment).record_digest != '') ||
          (needs.assess-installation.result == 'success' && fromJSON(needs.assess-installation.outputs.assessment).record_digest != ''))
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        env:
          ENGINE_ROOT: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && '.' || '.clouseau-ci' }}
        with:
          script: |
            const resolver = require(require('node:path').join(process.env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE, process.env.ENGINE_ROOT, 'src/acceptance-artifact.cjs'));
            core.setOutput('name', await resolver.resolveArtifactName({github, context, attempt: process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}));
      - name: Load this run's acceptance record
        if: steps.acceptance-artifact.outcome == 'success'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ steps.acceptance-artifact.outputs.name }}
          path: work
      - if: github.event_name == 'push' && !github.event.deleted && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/policy-install/')
        uses: ./
        with:
          operation: gate
          native-gate: 'true'
          assessment: ${{ needs.assess-intent.outputs.assessment || needs.assess-installation.outputs.assessment }}
          pull-request: ${{ needs.prepare-installation.outputs.number }}

      - if: github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && !github.event.pull_request.draft
        uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: gate
          native-gate: 'true'
          assessment: ${{ needs.assess-intent.outputs.assessment || needs.assess-installation.outputs.assessment }}
          pull-request: ${{ needs.prepare-installation.outputs.number }}

  apply-repair:
    needs: [assess-intent, approve-and-merge, resolve-clouseau]
    if: >-
      always() && github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && !github.event.pull_request.draft &&
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      needs.assess-intent.result == 'success' && needs.approve-and-merge.result == 'failure' &&
      fromJSON(needs.assess-intent.outputs.assessment).repair_digest != ''
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
      pull-requests: read
      actions: read
    concurrency:
      group: pr-approval-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ github.event_name != 'push' && needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '' }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ github.event_name != 'push' && needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest || '' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        if: github.event_name != 'push'
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Locate this run's acceptance record
        id: acceptance-artifact
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const resolver = require(require('node:path').join(process.env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE, '.clouseau-ci/src/acceptance-artifact.cjs'));
            core.setOutput('name', await resolver.resolveArtifactName({github, context, attempt: process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}));
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ steps.acceptance-artifact.outputs.name }}
          path: work
      - uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: repair
          assessment: ${{ needs.assess-intent.outputs.assessment }}
          repair-token: ${{ secrets.DEPLOYMENT_TOKEN }}

  finalize-merge:
    needs: [assess-intent, approve-and-merge, resolve-clouseau]
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request_target'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      actions: write
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ github.event_name != 'push' && needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '' }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ github.event_name != 'push' && needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest || '' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        if: github.event_name != 'push'
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: finalize
          assessment: ${{ needs.assess-intent.outputs.assessment }}

  reconcile-base:
    # A sibling merge moves the base under every approved PR; nothing else re-checks them.
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
    needs: resolve-clouseau
    concurrency:
      group: clouseau-reconcile-base
      cancel-in-progress: false
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: reconcile-base
          update-token: ${{ secrets.BRANCH_UPDATE_TOKEN }}

  request-reassessment:
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && github.event.issue.pull_request && (startsWith(github.event.comment.body, '/approve-intent ') || startsWith(github.event.comment.body, '/hosted-review '))) ||
      (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.pull_request != '' && !inputs.evaluate_acceptance)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 3
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      actions: write
    needs: resolve-clouseau
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ github.event_name != 'push' && needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '' }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ github.event_name != 'push' && needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest || '' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        if: github.event_name != 'push'
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: request-reassessment
          pull-request: ${{ inputs.pull_request }}
